sources.note: Nothing for Maremgi. Checklist entry no. 78 MAREMGI (p. 39): 'Dialects: ? Villages: ? Source: Galis 1955 (N, Wl; S)'. The comparative-wordlist orthography note (p. 92) says 'Stress and pitch are not indicated'; p. 108 gives only 7 Maremgi items (egg, fire, one, pig, stone, two, water) after Galis.
No phonology section; references only Ethnologue, Voorhoeve 1975, Rosetta Swadesh list.
